verdict.rationale: Pilot is a tech-enabled accounting, bookkeeping and tax service with a customer portal and AI answers. Whether a software-backed service publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public repository, published source code or an open-source license, and the only probes found an llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, which says nothing about source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
